title: Create a SOCKS proxy via SSH dynamic port forwarding
summary: Set up a dynamic port forwarding tunnel that acts as a SOCKS proxy. This allows you to route web traffic or other applications through the remote server.

steps.explain: Use the -D flag to create a SOCKS proxy on a local port. Applications configured to use this proxy will route their traffic through the SSH connection.

placeholders.name: USERNAME
placeholders.description: The username on the remote server

placeholders.name: REMOTE_HOST
placeholders.description: The hostname or IP address of the remote server

placeholders.name: LOCAL_PORT
placeholders.description: The local port to bind the SOCKS proxy to
